data.one_liner: Checks for newer app versions on multiple app stores with a single API call
data.what_it_does: The plugin queries Google Play, Apple App Store, RuStore, AppGallery, and ApkPure to determine the latest published version of an app. It returns the current, store, and URL information along with a flag indicating whether an update is available.
use_when: You need to prompt users to update without a backend
You want to support multiple app stores in one call
You need semver‑aware comparison and regional storefront support
avoid_when: You only target a single store
You require web or desktop support
You need to customize the network layer beyond http.Client
strengths: Lightweight – only http and meta dependencies
No need for package_info_plus – reads metadata natively
Supports regional storefronts and semver comparison
weaknesses: Android/iOS only – no web, Windows, Linux, macOS support
data.setup_notes: Add the plugin via pub add; the plugin declares INTERNET permission automatically. No build_runner or codegen required.
